name: @backend/libs-proxy
description: Tailnet read proxy for the private Cargo registry: serves the sparse index and .crate files out of the libs bucket through a read link it never reveals. Rust (rs/, core/); its flow tests drive the router in-process and a real Cargo client (rs/tests/flow.rs).

scripts.test:flow: cargo test --locked -p libs-proxy-core -p libs-proxy-rs --test flow --manifest-path Cargo.toml
